decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the premises Unit 5 Cavendish Parade shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a  hot food takeaway, shall not take place anywhere on the site except within building.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 10:00am to  02:00 Sunday to Thursday  11:00am to 03:00. Friday to Saturday and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 5 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times 10:00am to 03.00 weekdays and Saturdays11:00am to 02.00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a  hot food take away shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the property and the adjoining residential and commercial units (including upper floor flats), has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted scheme shall include provision of means of ventilation to allow the use to operate with windows shut at all times and any doors being self closing and all such windows and doors shall be kept shut while the wine bar is open. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of hours of operation and addtions and alterations to an existing building, including an A5 takeaway element.
